messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Business Services and Partnerships" as it appears in the following examples.
['These directives are to be emailed and followed by all customers of the Commercial Treasury Management.', 'Our Sharing Ratio Will Be 60:40.', 'I came to know of you in my private search for a reliable and reputable person to handle this confidential transaction, which involves the transfer of a huge sum of money to a foreign Bank Account requiring maximum confidence.', 'We will offer you 15% of the total sum of US$9Million as fee for your efforts and support.', 'The money will be paid into your account for us to share in the ratio of 60% for me and 40% for you.', 'Thereafter, I will come for the sharing and investment, also to use part of the money to help the Iranians, It is a careful network and for the past eleven months I have worked out everything to ensure a hitch-free operation.', 'Mega Meeting Meeting Online is cost-effective, efficient and easy Easy to Use, Affordable Web and Video Conferencing Software is Here!', 'And Moreover we agreed to give you 30% of the total funds for your kindly assistance and to remain 70% for invest into any reliable business over there you suggest that is profitable.', 'Can I really trust you to hold this money for me until I arrive your country and pick it up myself, and you deduct 30% of the total money as your commission if you accept my offer you can contact me immediately?', 'We have agreed to give you from the total sum 20% for helpings to move this money to your country while 80% Willie for me and my family to invest in your country.', 'I will be needing your assistance as my foreign partner to invest this fund in your country, you are to be my front and guide for this purpose.', 'or better still commit it into viable Joint venture projects with you.', 'And we wish to invest in Manufacturing and real estate management in your country.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
